threat_event: Ransomware enters the corporate network and crosses the IT/OT boundary into the dispatch zones, encrypting the CAD/CTC primary and standby servers, the BOS, and consoles
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Flat field backhaul; CAD/CTC servers 14 months behind on patches; standby replicates in real time; restore from backup untested; OT isolation never exercised
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01; SYS-02; SYS-09 dispatch zones; BP-01 to BP-03
sp800_53_controls: CP-9; CP-10; CP-4; SC-7; AC-4; SI-2; IR-3
existing_controls: IT/OT boundary firewalls (deny by default); EDR on consoles and servers; PAM jump host for CAD and PTC vendors; write-once backups in a separate account; MSSP 24x7 on IT
treatment_plan: Clean-room recovery environment and quarterly CAD/CTC and BOS restore tests; patch CAD/CTC to the vendor-certified level; IT/OT isolation exercise with operations; manual dispatch drill in CTC territory
exposure_estimate_usd: $1.2M-$3.5M (network degraded 3 or more days, response, recovery; insurance limit $15M)

threat_event: Ransomware with data theft on corporate IT (email, file services, ERP) without reaching OT; employee data and SSI copies are posted for extortion
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SSI copies outside the restricted library; employee medical certification data in the ERP; phishing remains the main entry
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-11; SYS-12; SYS-08 corporate workloads; BP-13 to BP-15
existing_controls: EDR; MSSP; MFA for all users; email security
treatment_plan: Remove SSI copies and add data loss rules for SSI markings; egress volume alerting on file services; tabletop with General Counsel
exposure_estimate_usd: $600K-$2M (notification of about 2,400 current and former employees, counsel, forensics, TSA SSI follow-up)

threat_event: After a cyber event the CAD/CTC system cannot be restored within its 2-hour RTO because the standby holds the same corruption and no backup restore has been tested
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No end-to-end restore test; no clean rebuild environment; restore runbook incomplete
existing_controls: Write-once daily backups and weekly images; backups scanned at backup time; standby at the backup NOC
treatment_plan: First end-to-end restore test 2026-11-05; then quarterly; clean-room environment by 2027-03-31; delayed-replication snapshot on the standby

threat_event: Attacker reaches the flat field backhaul through a tower site or a detector cellular modem and sends false requests to CTC field controllers or suppresses detector alarms
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No zones inside the backhaul; field controllers authenticate by address only; no monitoring of field zones
existing_controls: Vital field logic will not clear a conflicting route; locked housings; radio link encryption on the code line
treatment_plan: Field zone segmentation with OT firewalls at tower sites; OT sensors at 6 hub towers; controller authentication upgrade with the vendor
exposure_estimate_usd: $500K-$5M (service disruption; safety event possible if combined with a crew error)

threat_event: A dispatcher issues conflicting authority or loses roadway worker protection during an unpracticed switch to manual dispatch in CTC territory
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manual dispatch drilled only in track warrant territory; procedure not tied to a cyber trigger
existing_controls: Manual dispatch procedure (paper warrants); radio repeat-back rules; vital field logic
treatment_plan: CTC-territory manual dispatch drill on 2026-12-10 and twice a year after; add cyber triggers to the procedure; train all 36 dispatchers
exposure_estimate_usd: $1M-$20M if a collision occurs (low frequency, severe outcome)

threat_event: A departed signal maintainer who still knows a shared field controller password changes a controller configuration
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 shared maintainer accounts per platform unchanged since 2023
existing_controls: Locked housings; vital logic; change records for planned work
treatment_plan: Rotate all shared field passwords now and at each departure; vault them in the PAM tool; move to named accounts where the platform allows

threat_event: The radio system vendor's or detector vendor's always-on remote access is compromised and used to enter the backhaul
threat_source: Supply chain attacker via a vendor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Always-on site-to-site VPN and cellular modems outside the PAM jump host; no vendor security terms
existing_controls: Vendor accounts named; VPN logs reviewed monthly
treatment_plan: Move both vendors to the PAM jump host with MFA and per-session approval; disconnect detector modems' inbound access; add security terms at renewal

threat_event: Attacker exploits a known-exploited vulnerability in CTC field controller firmware
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2 firmware versions with KEV entries; no documented mitigation or timeline
existing_controls: Controllers reachable only from the backhaul; vital logic
treatment_plan: Vendor-certified firmware upgrade at 41 affected locations; documented mitigations and timeline in the patch strategy until done

threat_event: Attacker already in the dispatch zone exploits the unpatched CAD/CTC server operating system
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Servers 14 months behind vendor-certified patches because of slow vendor certification
existing_controls: EDR; boundary firewalls; application allowlisting on consoles
treatment_plan: Bring servers to the current certified level; contract a 60-day certification commitment; compensating EDR rules for KEV items in the meantime

threat_event: A TSA inspection finds measures in the approved CIP and CAP not carried out (field zone milestone missed, one-third assessment minimum not met, architecture design review overdue)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CIP milestones not tracked to closure; CAP schedule not resourced
existing_controls: CAP annual report filed on time; POA&M exists
treatment_plan: Architecture design review 2026-11; P07 counts toward the plan year; notify TSA of the field zone delay and file a CIP schedule amendment; monthly CIP milestone tracking by the COO

threat_event: A cyber incident is not reported to CISA within 72 hours with the content the directive requires, or the 1570.203 duty is missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Report template lacked the directive statement until 2026-09; chief dispatchers not trained on cyber triggers
existing_controls: Coordinators reachable 24/7; reporting steps in the plan
treatment_plan: New template with the SD statement; TSOC early call within 12 hours as company practice; train chief dispatchers; quarterly reporting drill

threat_event: TSA requests RSSM car locations during an IT or TMS outage and the answer takes longer than 30 minutes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Fallback relies on a 4-hourly printed list and a standby laptop extract; cars in trains need train sheets
existing_controls: Printed RSSM list every 4 hours at both NOCs; quarterly TSA-style drills (all passed, best 11 minutes)
treatment_plan: Add an outage-mode drill with the TMS unavailable; extract every 2 hours while PIH cars are in the HTUA
owner: Director of Safety, Security, and Hazmat

threat_event: The PTC back office is unavailable for more than 6 hours, so trackage-rights trains cannot initialize PTC and are held
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor support SLA 8 hours; failover tested once outside incident conditions
existing_controls: Standby BOS at the backup NOC; daily write-once backups
treatment_plan: Twice-yearly failover test under incident conditions; negotiate a 4-hour vendor response; reroute plan agreed with the Class I

threat_event: The TMS vendor suffers ransomware or an outage lasting several days, stopping consists, interchange EDI, car tracing, and the RSSM data feed
threat_source: TMS vendor infrastructure failure or cyber incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single SaaS provider; stated RTO 24 hours, longer than the BIA; no contractual recovery terms
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 Type 2 reviewed; 4-hourly extract
treatment_plan: Vendor outage runbook (P08); contract recovery terms and 24-hour incident notice at renewal; daily full car file extract to the company cloud
owner: Director of Customer Service and Car Management
exposure_estimate_usd: $260K for 72 hours; more for a multi-week outage

threat_event: Wrong consist data from the TMS causes PTC initialization failures or wrong hazmat car positions on train documents
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Consists built from EDI with manual corrections; validation only in the BOS
existing_controls: BOS consist validation; crew walk-by of hazmat cars
treatment_plan: Consist exception report reviewed by car management each shift
owner: Director of Customer Service and Car Management

threat_event: An attacker with BOS administrator access changes locomotive or crew data so PTC enforcement misbehaves on the host's line
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: BOS logs not in the SIEM; 3 administrator accounts
existing_controls: PAM jump host with MFA; host railroad's certified system checks
treatment_plan: Forward BOS logs to the SIEM; alert on data changes outside work orders

threat_event: The PTC vendor's managed-service session through the jump host is hijacked and used to reach the BOS
threat_source: Supply chain attacker via a vendor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor technicians use their own laptops to reach the jump host
existing_controls: MFA; per-session approval; session recording
treatment_plan: Require vendor endpoint attestation; review recordings monthly

threat_event: Default credentials on detector modems or crossing monitors are used to change settings or suppress alarm messages
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Default vendor passwords on some devices (P07 found 7 of 30 sampled); legacy unencrypted links at 6 towers
existing_controls: Detector logic standalone; crews receive voice alarms
treatment_plan: Change all default credentials; add device credentials to the PAM vault; encrypt the 6 legacy links

threat_event: An investigation cannot scope an incident or supply the directive's report content because CAD/CTC, BOS, and field logs are missing or expired
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Application and field logs local only, about 30 days
existing_controls: SIEM for IT; OT sensors at the NOCs
treatment_plan: Forward CAD/CTC, BOS, and field logs; 1 year searchable, 3 years archive

threat_event: An intruder stays undetected for weeks in the field zones and prepares a disruptive attack
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT monitoring covers only the NOCs and the data center; MSSP contract excludes OT
existing_controls: OT sensors at NOCs; weekly review
treatment_plan: Extend the MSSP contract to OT alerts; sensors at 6 hub towers; monthly threat hunt

threat_event: Adversary-in-the-middle phishing steals an office user's session and the attacker reads mail or moves to cloud file services
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Push MFA (not phishing-resistant) for office users
existing_controls: Email security; MFA with number matching; MSSP alerts on risky sign-ins
treatment_plan: Token protection and phishing-resistant MFA for finance, HR, and IT users

threat_event: Business email compromise redirects a shipper refund or vendor payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bank detail changes verified by email only for small vendors
existing_controls: Call-back verification above $25,000
treatment_plan: Call-back for every bank detail change; finance training

threat_event: An administrator account on the identity provider or PAM tool is taken over, giving the attacker access to every TDPO component
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Small number of super-administrators; break-glass accounts not tested quarterly
existing_controls: FIDO2 keys for administrators; PAM; alerts on role changes
treatment_plan: Quarterly break-glass test; separate admin workstation for IdP and PAM administrators

threat_event: A former employee uses a crew tablet or TMS account that was not disabled on time
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tablet and TMS accounts disabled up to 5 days late
existing_controls: MDM remote wipe; tablet apps behind the app gateway
treatment_plan: Add tablets and the TMS to automated deprovisioning

threat_event: Actions taken on the shared dispatcher logins at the backup NOC cannot be tied to a person, hiding misuse or error
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2 shared logins at the backup NOC
existing_controls: Backup NOC badge access; dispatcher radio log
treatment_plan: Remove shared logins; named accounts for all backup NOC staff

threat_event: SSI (CIP, CAP, network designs) is disclosed to people without a need to know, inside or outside the company
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Copies in 2 broad file shares; unmarked drafts
existing_controls: Restricted SSI library with need-to-know groups
treatment_plan: Remove copies; marking check before filing; quarterly library access review; SSI training for engineering and IT
owner: Director of Safety, Security, and Hazmat

threat_event: A hurricane damages the HQ campus, taking the primary NOC and the HQ data center out of service for days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Primary NOC and primary CAD/CTC and BOS on the same campus
existing_controls: Backup NOC 150 miles away with standby servers; semiannual failover drills
treatment_plan: Pre-storm move of dispatchers to the backup NOC per the hurricane plan; generator fuel contract

threat_event: A single storm affects both the HQ campus and the Jacksonville backup NOC
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Both NOCs in north Florida
existing_controls: Generators at both sites; storm staffing plan
treatment_plan: Third-site option: rebuild dispatch servers in the cloud clean-room environment for emergency read access to train sheets; affiliate agreement for emergency dispatch support

threat_event: Loss of a leased circuit cuts the code line to 11 control points
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One leased circuit is a single path
existing_controls: Manual dispatch for affected control points
treatment_plan: Add microwave path for the 11 control points

threat_event: Backups in the backup account are deleted or encrypted together with production
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: None material: write-once retention, separate credentials, second region
existing_controls: 35-day write-once vault; separate administrators; deletion alerts
treatment_plan: Accepted by the COO 2026-09-15: within appetite because the vault is write-once and isolated; re-review after the clean-room build

threat_event: An attacker exploits a known-exploited vulnerability in the internet-facing VPN or firewall appliance
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Edge appliances patched monthly; KEV items within 14 days
existing_controls: KEV watch; MSSP alerts; MFA on VPN
treatment_plan: 72-hour emergency patch path for edge KEV items

threat_event: A cloud misconfiguration exposes file services or the AI image store to the internet
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Guardrails block public storage, but exceptions are possible for vendor sharing
existing_controls: Organization guardrails; posture service alerts
treatment_plan: Monthly posture review; exception approvals by the Cybersecurity Manager

threat_event: An identity provider outage blocks remote and privileged access during an incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PAM and VPN depend on the IdP
existing_controls: Break-glass accounts; on-premises directory continues for consoles
treatment_plan: Document IdP-independent access path for the incident team

threat_event: The MSSP misses an OT attack because its contract excludes OT and OT alerts are reviewed weekly
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT alerts reviewed weekly by one engineer
existing_controls: OT sensors at the NOCs
treatment_plan: Extend MSSP scope to OT sensor alerts with 30-minute escalation

threat_event: Crossing monitors and detector modems past vendor support develop flaws that cannot be fixed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 18 crossing monitors and 4 detector modems unsupported
existing_controls: Devices behind cellular private APN
treatment_plan: Replacement in the 2027 capital plan

threat_event: An intruder enters a tower shelter or signal housing with a copied common key and tampers with equipment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 common keys held by about 90 people; incomplete key logs
existing_controls: Locked housings and shelters; door alarms at 12 hub towers
treatment_plan: Restricted-keyway locks and door alarms at all 38 towers
owner: Director of Safety, Security, and Hazmat

threat_event: Someone tampers with an onboard PTC unit on an unattended locomotive
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Locomotives tie up at remote sidings
existing_controls: Locked and sealed housings; exterior cab locks (232.105(h)); daily inspection (229.21)
treatment_plan: Accepted by the PTC Program Manager: physical measures documented in the CIP under SD III.C.6

threat_event: A lost or stolen crew tablet exposes train lists and bulletins
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 410 tablets in the field
existing_controls: MDM encryption, passcode, and remote wipe
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Director of IT: residual risk Low

threat_event: Denial of service against the public website and shipper portal
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Portal is the TMS vendor's; website on a hosting service
existing_controls: Vendor DDoS protection; phone and email ordering
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Director of Customer Service and Car Management
owner: Director of Customer Service and Car Management

threat_event: Employee personal information, including engineer and conductor certification and medical records, is stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Records in the ERP and in HR file shares
existing_controls: ERP MFA and role controls; vendor SOC 2
treatment_plan: Move medical records out of file shares into the ERP; quarterly HR access review

threat_event: The AI-001 vendor keeps or reuses track, bridge, and signal imagery, or its service account reaches other company data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Contract silent on data use; service account had read access to all corporate storage until 2026-09
existing_controls: Service account restricted in 2026-09
treatment_plan: Contract amendment: no reuse without consent, deletion at end, 24-hour incident notice (P10)

threat_event: The AI-001 model misses a defect and inspectors start relying on it instead of the required visual inspection
threat_source: AI model error and automation bias
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Recall below target in low light and on jointed rail; inspectors check flagged spots first
existing_controls: Model only supplements inspection; inspector decision recorded for each flag
treatment_plan: Written human-in-the-loop rule; inspector briefing; monthly recall by condition (P10)
exposure_estimate_usd: $100K-$10M if a missed defect contributes to a derailment

threat_event: The AI-003 applicant screening feature ranks applicants in a way that disadvantages a protected group
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Feature turned on by the vendor default in 2026-02; no adverse impact analysis
existing_controls: Recruiters review every application
treatment_plan: Turn off automated ranking until an adverse impact analysis is done; quarterly selection-rate review (P10)

threat_event: Staff paste SSI or Restricted data into unapproved public generative AI tools
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Public tools reachable from office endpoints; enterprise assistant (AI-004) rolled out to only 120 users
existing_controls: POL-05 prohibits it; DNS filtering of some public tools
treatment_plan: Block public generative AI sites; extend AI-004 to all office users with no-training terms

threat_event: The shipper portal chatbot (AI-005) gives a shipper another shipper's car data or wrong hazmat information
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Chatbot reads car data through the portal session; no output testing for cross-customer data
existing_controls: Chatbot limited to the logged-in customer's cars by design
treatment_plan: Pre-release test of 50 cross-customer prompts; hazmat questions handed to staff (P10)
owner: Director of Customer Service and Car Management

threat_event: The locomotive telemetry vendor link (AI-002) is used as a path into onboard systems
threat_source: Supply chain attacker via a vendor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Telemetry gateway on 52 road locomotives connects to the vendor cloud
existing_controls: Gateway is read-only by design per the vendor; separate from PTC apparatus
treatment_plan: Confirm one-way design in writing; add the gateway to the OT inventory

threat_event: The shared dispatch service misses its 2-hour restoration commitment, or the SOC 2 Type 2 report is not ready, and the contracted short line ends the agreement
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Restoration objective equals the BIA RTO with no margin; SOC 2 gaps (P09)
existing_controls: Backup NOC; failover drills
treatment_plan: SOC 2 readiness plan (P09); restoration drills for affiliate desks
exposure_estimate_usd: $4M a year of service revenue at risk

threat_event: A field controller configuration is changed without a record, so CTC indications in the office no longer match the field
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Field changes made without tickets (6 of 20 sampled)
existing_controls: Signal test procedures after work
treatment_plan: Change tickets for every field configuration change; signed configuration archive

threat_event: In a real incident, IT/OT isolation is delayed or done wrong (trains stopped without need, or OT left exposed) because isolation was never exercised
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CIRP exercises tested IT objectives only; no isolation decision order
existing_controls: Boundary firewalls can be closed from the HQ data center
treatment_plan: Isolation decision order in P08; operations-led exercise 2026-12-10 testing II.D.1.a and II.D.1.c

threat_event: An attacker on a leased circuit intercepts or replays code line messages
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2 leased circuits carry unencrypted code line traffic
existing_controls: Vital field logic; carrier circuit isolation
treatment_plan: Encrypt the 2 circuits with the vendor's link encryption

threat_event: A disgruntled insider with administrator rights sabotages the CAD/CTC system
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2 maintainers also hold CAD/CTC administrator rights
existing_controls: PAM recording; background checks
treatment_plan: Remove dual rights; alert on administrator actions outside change windows

threat_event: A vendor CAD/CTC or BOS software update introduces a defect that takes dispatch down
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Updates tested on the vendor's system, not the company's configuration
existing_controls: Rollback plan per change; change advisory board
treatment_plan: Company test environment for CAD/CTC (in the clean-room build)
